meta.methodology: Read framework.md, torah_69_packages.json, all reference===69 edges from torahData.js, and the full source text torah_69.txt. For each bechina statement in the source text, verified whether the concept appears as a node in the dataset. Only concepts with explicit bechina language (בְּחִינַת, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת, נִקְרָא) or equivalent identity declarations were flagged. Eitza/causal statements and proof-text citations were excluded.

additions.reason: Source text line 8 states explicitly: 'כִּי הָאִשָּׁה הִיא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת הָאִילָן.' This is a direct bechina declaration: the wife (אשה) IS the bechina of the tree (אילן). The dataset has 'אור נפשה = עקר האילן' (edge 2441) but does not record 'אשה = אילן' as a direct node pair. The אשה-as-tree bechina is the primary statement from which the אור נפשה = tree-root bechina is derived; it is a gap that belongs in Package 1 (the wealth/tree cluster) because the אשה-tree identification IS the foundational metaphor of the entire Torah. The אשה's soul-light = tree root, her wealth = branches, her children = fruit.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הָאִשָּׁה הִיא עִקַּר בְּחִינַת הָאִילָן, וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת הֵם הָעֲנָפִים שֶׁל הָאִילָן, וְהַבָּנִים הֵם הַפֵּרוֹת הַגְּדֵלִים בָּעֲנָפִים הָאֵלּוּ

additions.reason: Source text line 17 contains an explicit bechina: 'לְמָדַי, בְּחִינַת לִמּוּדֵי ה' הַנַּ"ל.' The Rebbe interprets the Gemara's phrase 'yolichennu acharav afilu l'Madai' (Bava Kama 103) — he must follow the victim even to Media — as a concealed reference to 'limudei Hashem' (Torah-students/children). 'מָדַי' = 'לִמּוּדֵי ה'' through wordplay and deep interpretation. This is an explicit bechina-equivalence. It belongs in Package 3 (בנים/למודי ה') because 'למודי ה'' is already that package's node and 'מדי' is its decoded form in Gemara language.
additions.source_quote: לְמָדַי, בְּחִינַת לִמּוּדֵי ה', הַיְנוּ הַבָּנִים. שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְהַחֲזִיר לוֹ אֲפִלּוּ הַבָּנִים שֶׁגָּזַל מִמֶּנּוּ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁגָּזַל אֶת מָמוֹנוֹ

additions.reason: Source text line 44 states: 'שׂוֹנְאֵי חִנָּם בָּאִים מִבְּחִינַת שְׂעָרוֹת, מוֹתְרֵי מֹחִין.' additions.source_quote: שׂוֹנְאֵי חִנָּם בָּאִים מִבְּחִינַת שְׂעָרוֹת, מוֹתְרֵי מֹחִין כַּנַּ"ל, בְּחִינוֹת (תהילים ס"ט:ה'): רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שׂוֹנְאַי חִנָּם

additions.reason: Source text line 47 states: 'כִּי הוּא בַּעַל שֵׂעָר (מלכים ב א), שֶׁמְּמֻנֶּה עַל זֶה, עַל בְּחִינַת שְׂעָרוֹת, לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם דִּין.' additions.reason: Source text line 20-21 states: 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת קִדּוּשִׁין' and explains the mechanism: through the כֶּסֶף (money) given at kiddushin, the woman's soul-light is completed and she is extracted from among the klipot. concepts_examined_and_excluded.reason: Source text line 18 says 'כִּי בְּרוּחָנִיּוּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ מַרְגֶּשֶׁת... זֶה הַגַּזְלָן שֶׁהוּא כְּמוֹ רוֹצֵחַ נְפָשׁוֹת מַמָּשׁ.' These are scriptural citations used as analogies/evidence, not standalone bechina-declarations for new concept nodes.

Source text line 19 mentions trees in Hungary ('יֵשׁ אִילָנוֹת בִּמְדִינַת אוּנְגַרִין שֶׁכְּשֶׁאָדָם בָּא לִטְּלָם, הֵם מַמְשִׁיכִין וּמַקְטִינִים עַצְמָן') as a worldly analogy (dugma) for the nefesh contracting its light to prevent the robber from taking it. This is illustrative comparison (כְּמוֹ שֶׁיֵּשׁ דֻּגְמָתוֹ), not bechina language.

The ketubah is mentioned in lines 22-23 as the husband's commitment to support the wife financially. No explicit bechina declaration: 'כִּי הוּא בְּחִינַת הֲנָקַת הָאִילָן' is said about the husband's business activities, not about the ketubah as a concept-node in its own right.

Lines 23-25 discuss inheritance (ירושה) at length but use causal/eitza language throughout ('עַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁנִּפְטָר... הֵם מְקַבְּלִים וְיוֹרְשִׁים'). No explicit bechina-equivalence is stated for ירושה as a concept.

Lines 40-43 describe mental cloudiness (עֲכִירַת הַמֹּחַ) as the source of hatred. While this is stated as the root cause, it is framed as an eitza chain ('כִּי אַהֲבָה תְּלוּיָה בְּדַעַת וָשֵׂכֶל... כִּי עֲכִירַת הַמֹּחַ מָשָׁם יוֹנְקִים הַשּׂוֹנְאִים'), not as bechina-equivalence. The concept of עכירת מח was not declared as a bechina of another concept; it is a cause in a causal chain.
